description: This file provides a Swift implementation for transcoding JPEG images, including error handling, image resizing, quality adjustment, and optional size constraints.

classes.name: JPEGTranscodeError
classes.description: An enum representing possible errors during the JPEG transcoding process, conforming to LocalizedError to provide descriptive error messages.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoder
classes.description: A struct providing static methods for transcoding JPEG images, including quality clamping and the core transcodeToJPEG function.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Clamps a quality value between 0.05 and 1.0 to ensure valid JPEG compression quality.

methods.name: transcodeToJPEG
methods.description: Main function that re-encodes image data to JPEG, optionally resizing to fit within a maximum width, adjusting quality for size constraints, and normalizing EXIF orientation.
